metadata.description: Session handovers for coding agents that keep the soul of the work, verified by a fresh-agent exam.

plugins.name: shift-change
plugins.description: I-PASS handovers for coding agents: /shift-change hands your session to the next one and quizzes a fresh agent on it, /shift-start reads it back before acting, /shift-recover rebuilds a session that died without one, /shift-brief packages a task for a collaborator and cold-start tests the bundle.
